common_name: Break Out Dahlia (Blended Pink-Cream-Yellow Dinnerplate Dahlia)

planting.note: Plant tubers horizontally 4-6 inches deep after last frost; Break Out is a large AA-size dinnerplate dahlia with blended pink, cream, and soft yellow petals, a favorite for cut-flower growers.

directions: Plant tubers horizontally 4-6 inches deep with the growth eye facing up; stake plants at planting time since the massive flowers can topple stems in wind. Break Out bears huge, informal decorative blooms blending soft pink, cream, and pale yellow tones within each flower, a subtle, ever-shifting color combination that has made it a favorite among specialty cut-flower growers for its unusual, painterly palette. Disbud side buds to concentrate energy into fewer, larger blooms if maximum flower size is the goal, or leave them for more numerous, slightly smaller flowers. Deadhead spent blooms regularly, and lift and store tubers after frost blackens the foliage in zones colder than 8.
sources: Association of Specialty Cut Flower Growers
